desc: The cybersecurity strategy of the entity shall be identified, documented, and approved, and it shall be supported by the head of the entity or his/her delegate (hereinafter referred to as the “Authorized Official”). The strategy goals shall be in line with the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
ev:
• The cybersecurity strategy document approved by the entity (electronic copy or official hard copy).
• Initiatives and projects included in the cybersecurity strategy of the entity.

desc: The entity shall execute an action plan to apply the cybersecurity strategy.
ev:
• Strategy implementation roadmap
• List of cybersecurity projects and initiatives and their status

• An approved document that defines the review schedule for the cybersecurity strategy
• An updated cybersecurity strategy after documenting changes to the cybersecurity requirements and to be approved by the representative
• Project status reports
• Formal approval by the representative on the updated strategy (e.g., via the entity's official e-mail, paper or electronic signature)

desc: A department for cybersecurity shall be established within the entity. This department shall be independent from the Information Technology and Communications Department (As per High Order No. 37140, dated 14/08/1438H.). It is recommended that the Cybersecurity Department reports directly to the head of the entity or his/her delegate while ensuring that this does not result in a conflict of interests.
ev:
• The entity's organizational structure (electronic copy or official hard copy), covering the organizational structure of the cybersecurity function.
• The decision to establish the Cybersecurity functions and its mandate (electronic copy or official hard copy)
• Reports on the cybersecurity policies compliance results

desc: All cybersecurity positions shall be filled out with full-time and qualified Saudi cybersecurity professionals.

desc: A cybersecurity supervisory committee shall be established pursuant to the instruction of the entity's Authorized Official to ensure compliance with, support for, and monitoring of the implementation of cybersecurity programs and regulations. The committee's members, roles and responsibilities, and governance framework shall be identified, documented, and approved. The committee shall include the head of the cybersecurity department as a member. It is recommended that the committee reports directly to the head of the entity or his/her delegate while ensuring that this does not result in a conflict of interests.
ev:
• Supervisory committee charter in the entity. The charter clarifies the date of establishment of the committee and its reference and its approval by the entity's representative
• A documented and approved list showing the names of the entity's cybersecurity supervisory committee members
• Cybersecurity supervisory committee's agenda in the entity
• Minutes of meetings held for the cybersecurity supervisory committee at the entity

evAr:
• Screening/Vetting process defined and implemented for candidates with access to the Cloud Technology Stack, including a plan for periodic screening/vetting.
• Screening/Vetting reports for these candidates, with information privacy and sensitivity considered.

desc: Cybersecurity policies shall be a prerequisite for access to the Cloud Technology Stack and shall be signed and appropriately approved.
ev: • Cybersecurity policies acknowledgement and compliance form signed by all personnel working on the Cloud Technology Stack before access is granted.
descAr: يجب أن تكون سياسات الأمن السيبراني شرطًا مسبقًا للوصول إلى منظومة التقنية السحابية، وأن تكون موقّعة ومعتمدة بشكل مناسب.
evAr: • Cybersecurity policies acknowledgement and compliance form signed by all personnel working on the Cloud Technology Stack before access is granted.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 1-9-5, the following requirement shall be in place, as a minimum, for termination or completion of a human resource’s professional relationship with the CSP:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 1-9-5 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب توفر المتطلب التالي بحد أدنى عند إنهاء أو انتهاء العلاقة المهنية للموارد البشرية مع مقدّم الخدمة السحابية:

desc: Assurance that assets owned by the organization, especially those with security exposure, are accounted for and returned upon termination.
ev: • Signed clearance forms that include employees’ acknowledgement to return all organization assets, validated by the concerned department.
descAr: التأكد من حصر الأصول المملوكة للجهة وإعادتها عند انتهاء العلاقة الوظيفية، وخصوصًا الأصول ذات الحساسية الأمنية.
evAr: • Signed clearance forms that include employees’ acknowledgement to return all organization assets, validated by the concerned department.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for change management within the CSP shall be identified, documented, and approved.
ev:
• Cybersecurity change management policy approved by the organization.
• Formal approval by the head of the organization or his/her deputy on the policy.
descAr: يجب تحديد وتوثيق واعتماد متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لإدارة التغيير لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity change management policy approved by the organization.
• Formal approval by the head of the organization or his/her deputy on the policy.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for change management within the CSP shall be applied.
ev:
• Documents confirming the implementation of cybersecurity requirements for change management, as documented in the policy.
• Document that clarifies an action plan for implementing cybersecurity requirements for change management.
descAr: يجب تطبيق متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لإدارة التغيير لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr:
• Documents confirming the implementation of cybersecurity requirements for change management, as documented in the policy.
• Document that clarifies an action plan for implementing cybersecurity requirements for change management.

desc: Cybersecurity for change management in the CSP shall cover, as a minimum:
descAr: يجب أن يغطي الأمن السيبراني لإدارة التغيير لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية بحد أدنى ما يلي:

desc: Processes and procedures to securely implement planned changes in production systems, with priority given to cybersecurity observations.
ev:
• Change management procedures that prioritize implementation of changes related to cybersecurity.
• Evidence demonstrating verification of secure procedures during execution of changes.
descAr: العمليات والإجراءات اللازمة لتطبيق التغييرات المخطط لها في أنظمة الإنتاج بشكل آمن، مع إعطاء الأولوية لملاحظات الأمن السيبراني.
evAr:
• Change management procedures that prioritize implementation of changes related to cybersecurity.
• Evidence demonstrating verification of secure procedures during execution of changes.

desc: A process for implementing exceptional cybersecurity changes, such as changes during incident restoration.
ev:
• Document containing procedures for implementing exceptional changes.
• Evidence demonstrating technical capability for monitoring and controlling changes.
descAr: إجراء لتطبيق تغييرات الأمن السيبراني الاستثنائية، مثل التغييرات أثناء التعافي من الحوادث.
evAr:
• Document containing procedures for implementing exceptional changes.
• Evidence demonstrating technical capability for monitoring and controlling changes.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for change management within the CSP shall be applied and reviewed periodically.
ev:
• Log of updates and changes to the cybersecurity requirements for change management.
• Approved document that sets the policy review schedule.
• Policy indicating that it has been reviewed and updated and that changes have been documented and approved.
• Formal approval by the head of the organization or his/her deputy on the updated policy.
descAr: يجب تطبيق متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لإدارة التغيير لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية ومراجعتها دوريًا.
evAr:
• Log of updates and changes to the cybersecurity requirements for change management.
• Approved document that sets the policy review schedule.
• Policy indicating that it has been reviewed and updated and that changes have been documented and approved.
• Formal approval by the head of the organization or his/her deputy on the updated policy.

desc: In addition to the controls in ECC control 2-1, the CSP shall cover the following additional controls for asset management, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الواردة في الضابط 2-1 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الإضافية التالية لإدارة الأصول بحد أدنى:

desc: Inventory of all information and technology assets using suitable techniques, such as a Configuration Management Database (CMDB) or a similar capability containing an inventory of all technical assets.
ev:
• Asset inventory techniques identified and utilized.
• Document outlining the inventory of technical assets specific to cloud systems.
• Organization information and technology asset information maintained within an asset inventory, such as a CMDB.
descAr: حصر جميع الأصول المعلوماتية والتقنية باستخدام تقنيات مناسبة، مثل قاعدة بيانات إدارة الإعدادات (CMDB) أو قدرة مماثلة تتضمن حصرًا لجميع الأصول التقنية.
evAr:
• Asset inventory techniques identified and utilized.
• Document outlining the inventory of technical assets specific to cloud systems.
• Organization information and technology asset information maintained within an asset inventory, such as a CMDB.

desc: Identifying asset owners and involving them in the asset management lifecycle.
ev:
• Document outlining the asset inventory and the owners assigned to the assets.
• Evidence demonstrating that the roles and responsibilities of asset owners are aligned with their respective assets.
descAr: تحديد مالكي الأصول وإشراكهم في دورة حياة إدارة الأصول.
evAr:
• Document outlining the asset inventory and the owners assigned to the assets.
• Evidence demonstrating that the roles and responsibilities of asset owners are aligned with their respective assets.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-2-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for identity and access management, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-2-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لإدارة هويات الدخول والصلاحيات بحد أدنى:

desc: Identity and access management of generic account credentials for which accountability cannot be assigned to a specific individual.
ev:
• Document outlining the list of users of generic accounts, including service and technical accounts.
• Technical restrictions applied to the use and management of generic accounts.
descAr: إدارة هويات الدخول والصلاحيات لبيانات اعتماد الحسابات العامة التي لا يمكن إسناد المسؤولية عنها لشخص محدد.
evAr:
• Document outlining the list of users of generic accounts, including service and technical accounts.
• Technical restrictions applied to the use and management of generic accounts.

desc: Secure session management, including session authenticity, session lockout, and session timeout termination.
ev: • Evidence demonstrating configurations applied to sessions, including authenticity, lockout, and timeout.
descAr: الإدارة الآمنة للجلسات، بما في ذلك موثوقية الجلسة وإقفالها وإنهاؤها عند انتهاء المهلة.
evAr: • Evidence demonstrating configurations applied to sessions, including authenticity, lockout, and timeout.

desc: Multi-factor authentication for privileged users and personnel candidates with access to the Cloud Technology Stack.
ev:
• List of privileged accounts with access to Cloud Technology Systems (CTS).
• Multi-factor authentication technologies implemented for privileged accounts with access to Cloud Technology Systems.
descAr: التحقق من الهوية متعدد العناصر للمستخدمين ذوي الصلاحيات الهامة والمرشحين للعمل ممن لديهم وصول إلى منظومة التقنية السحابية.
evAr:
• List of privileged accounts with access to Cloud Technology Systems (CTS).
• Multi-factor authentication technologies implemented for privileged accounts with access to Cloud Technology Systems.

desc: A formal process to detect and prevent unauthorized access, such as unsuccessful login-attempt thresholds.
ev:
• Authentication and monitoring of access.
• The number of allowed access attempts is limited and the account is temporarily closed when the limit is exceeded.
• Sample system configuration and monitoring report.
• Access-attempt alerts.
descAr: إجراء رسمي لاكتشاف ومنع الوصول غير المصرّح به، مثل تحديد حد أقصى لمحاولات تسجيل الدخول الفاشلة.
evAr:
• Authentication and monitoring of access.
• The number of allowed access attempts is limited and the account is temporarily closed when the limit is exceeded.
• Sample system configuration and monitoring report.
• Access-attempt alerts.

desc: Utilizing secure methods and algorithms for saving and processing passwords, such as secure hashing functions.
ev:
• Evidence demonstrating a sample of stored passwords.
• Document outlining the standard applied to password storage.
descAr: استخدام طرق وخوارزميات آمنة لحفظ كلمات المرور ومعالجتها، مثل دوال التجزئة الآمنة.
evAr:
• Evidence demonstrating a sample of stored passwords.
• Document outlining the standard applied to password storage.

desc: Secure management of third-party personnel accounts.
ev:
• Restrictions implemented for third-party accounts based on approved standards.
• Procedures adopted for managing third-party accounts during their lifecycle.
• Sample third-party account requests showing the necessary approvals.
• Sample third-party account activity-monitoring logs.
• Defined labels for third-party accounts.
• Implemented Federated Identities and Authentication.
• Third-party account and privilege review plan and reports.
descAr: الإدارة الآمنة لحسابات العاملين من الأطراف الخارجية.
evAr:
• Restrictions implemented for third-party accounts based on approved standards.
• Procedures adopted for managing third-party accounts during their lifecycle.
• Sample third-party account requests showing the necessary approvals.
• Sample third-party account activity-monitoring logs.
• Defined labels for third-party accounts.
• Implemented Federated Identities and Authentication.
• Third-party account and privilege review plan and reports.

desc: Access control enforced for management systems and administrative consoles.
ev:
• List of management systems and administrative consoles.
• Sample requests for access to management systems and administrative consoles.
• Access privilege review plan and review reports for management systems and administrative consoles.
• Evidence of using Privileged Access Management (PAM) technology.
• Evidence of encryption for access communications through the network and a list of activated encryption algorithms.
• Evidence of Multi-Factor Authentication implementation.
• Sample event monitoring and related alerts from a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system.
• Sample recording of sessions.
descAr: تطبيق التحكم في الوصول على أنظمة الإدارة ولوحات التحكم الإدارية.
evAr:
• List of management systems and administrative consoles.
• Sample requests for access to management systems and administrative consoles.
• Access privilege review plan and review reports for management systems and administrative consoles.
• Evidence of using Privileged Access Management (PAM) technology.
• Evidence of encryption for access communications through the network and a list of activated encryption algorithms.
• Evidence of Multi-Factor Authentication implementation.
• Sample event monitoring and related alerts from a Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system.
• Sample recording of sessions.

desc: Masking displayed authentication inputs, especially passwords, to prevent shoulder surfing.
ev: • Evidence demonstrating implementation of obfuscation and masking of sensitive and personal information.
descAr: إخفاء مدخلات التحقق من الهوية المعروضة، وخصوصًا كلمات المرور، لمنع التلصص البصري.
evAr: • Evidence demonstrating implementation of obfuscation and masking of sensitive and personal information.

desc: Obtaining the CST’s approval before the CSP or a CSP third party accesses any CST-related asset or data.
ev:
• Approved procedures for requesting access to the CST’s assets or data.
• Sample approval requests.
descAr: الحصول على موافقة الجهة المستفيدة قبل وصول مقدّم الخدمة السحابية أو أي طرف خارجي تابع له إلى أي أصل أو بيانات تخص الجهة المستفيدة.
evAr:
• Approved procedures for requesting access to the CST’s assets or data.
• Sample approval requests.

desc: Capability to immediately interrupt a remote access session and prevent any future access for a user.
ev:
• Controlled remote access sessions established.
• Sample system or proxy configurations.
descAr: القدرة على قطع جلسة الوصول عن بُعد فورًا ومنع أي وصول مستقبلي للمستخدم.
evAr:
• Controlled remote access sessions established.
• Sample system or proxy configurations.

desc: Provision to CSTs of multi-factor authentication services for privileged cloud users.
ev: • Evidence demonstrating that cloud services are authenticated using multi-factor authentication.
descAr: توفير خدمات التحقق من الهوية متعدد العناصر للجهات المستفيدة للمستخدمين السحابيين ذوي الصلاحيات الهامة.
evAr: • Evidence demonstrating that cloud services are authenticated using multi-factor authentication.

desc: Assurance of restricted and controlled access to storage systems and storage means, such as Storage Area Networks (SAN).
ev:
• Access policy for storage systems.
• Asset register containing storage systems.
• Sample access-policy implementation for storage systems.
• Sample architecture design of storage systems.
• Sample access requests for storage systems.
descAr: ضمان تقييد الوصول إلى أنظمة ووسائط التخزين والتحكم فيه، مثل شبكات تخزين البيانات (SAN).
evAr:
• Access policy for storage systems.
• Asset register containing storage systems.
• Sample access-policy implementation for storage systems.
• Sample architecture design of storage systems.
• Sample access requests for storage systems.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-3-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for information system and processing facilities protection, as a minimum:
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-3-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لحماية الأنظمة وأجهزة معالجة المعلومات بحد أدنى:

desc: Ensuring that all configurations are applied in accordance with the CSP’s cybersecurity standards.
ev:
• Approved cybersecurity standards for information systems.
• Checklist for applying standards to configurations before deployment and before changes are applied.
• Review plan for information system configurations and review reports.
• Sample event logs for monitoring configuration changes.
• Restrictions applied to configuration modification and the list of personnel permitted to change configurations.
• Sample configuration-change requests.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: التأكد من تطبيق جميع الإعدادات وفقًا لمعايير الأمن السيبراني لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr:
• Approved cybersecurity standards for information systems.
• Checklist for applying standards to configurations before deployment and before changes are applied.
• Review plan for information system configurations and review reports.
• Sample event logs for monitoring configuration changes.
• Restrictions applied to configuration modification and the list of personnel permitted to change configurations.
• Sample configuration-change requests.

desc: Assurance of separation and isolation of data, environments, and information systems across CSTs to prevent data commingling.
ev:
• Verified separation of data and systems across CSTs.
• Test reports validating the prevention of data commingling.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: ضمان فصل وعزل البيانات والبيئات وأنظمة المعلومات بين الجهات المستفيدة لمنع اختلاط البيانات.
evAr:
• Verified separation of data and systems across CSTs.
• Test reports validating the prevention of data commingling.

desc: Adopting cybersecurity principles for technical system configurations according to the minimum-functionality principle.
ev:
• Minimum-functionality requirements defined for the configuration and functionality of technologies, systems, software, and services.
• Configuration audit reports demonstrating compliance with the specified requirements.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: تبنّي مبادئ الأمن السيبراني في إعدادات الأنظمة التقنية وفقًا لمبدأ الحد الأدنى من الوظائف.
evAr:
• Minimum-functionality requirements defined for the configuration and functionality of technologies, systems, software, and services.
• Configuration audit reports demonstrating compliance with the specified requirements.

desc: The ability of the Cloud Technology Stack to securely handle input validation, exceptions, and failures.
ev:
• Sample configuration for input validation.
• Sample evidence of automatic monitoring and logging to capture exceptions and failures.
• Evidence confirming logging and monitoring of alerts and audit reports.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: قدرة منظومة التقنية السحابية على التعامل الآمن مع التحقق من المدخلات والاستثناءات وحالات الفشل.
evAr:
• Sample configuration for input validation.
• Sample evidence of automatic monitoring and logging to capture exceptions and failures.
• Evidence confirming logging and monitoring of alerts and audit reports.

desc: Full isolation of security functions and applications from other functions and applications in the Cloud Technology Stack.
ev:
• Document demonstrating that security functions and applications are isolated from other functions and applications in the Cloud Technology Stack.
• Architecture design documentation.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: العزل الكامل لوظائف وتطبيقات الأمن عن باقي الوظائف والتطبيقات في منظومة التقنية السحابية.
evAr:
• Document demonstrating that security functions and applications are isolated from other functions and applications in the Cloud Technology Stack.
• Architecture design documentation.

desc: Notifying CSTs of cybersecurity requirements provided by the CSP and applicable for use by CSTs.
ev:
• Document describing the cybersecurity requirements provided by the service provider and methods of activating them on subscriber services.
• Evidence demonstrating communication to subscribers of requirements that can be activated upon request.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: إشعار الجهات المستفيدة بمتطلبات الأمن السيبراني التي يوفرها مقدّم الخدمة والقابلة للاستخدام من قِبلها.
evAr:
• Document describing the cybersecurity requirements provided by the service provider and methods of activating them on subscriber services.
• Evidence demonstrating communication to subscribers of requirements that can be activated upon request.

desc: Detection and prevention of unauthorized changes to software and systems.
ev:
• Cybersecurity requirements for change management.
• Evidence confirming applied restrictions that prevent, detect, and remediate unauthorized changes.
• Evidence illustrating system configurations for change-prevention tools.
• Change monitoring reports or alerts.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: اكتشاف ومنع التغييرات غير المصرّح بها على البرمجيات والأنظمة.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity requirements for change management.
• Evidence confirming applied restrictions that prevent, detect, and remediate unauthorized changes.
• Evidence illustrating system configurations for change-prevention tools.
• Change monitoring reports or alerts.

desc: Complete isolation and protection of multiple guest environments.
ev:
• Guest environments isolated.
• Architectural design document for hosting environments illustrating isolation.
• Sample virtual-environment threat model.
• Sample test report.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: العزل الكامل والحماية للبيئات الضيفة المتعددة.
evAr:
• Guest environments isolated.
• Architectural design document for hosting environments illustrating isolation.
• Sample virtual-environment threat model.
• Sample test report.

desc: Community cloud services provided to CSTs, including government and Critical National Infrastructure organizations, shall be isolated from any other cloud computing provided outside the scope of work.
ev:
• Architectural design documentation.
• Sample isolation mechanisms implemented between cloud services provided to government and sensitive-infrastructure entities and cloud services provided to other external entities.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: يجب عزل الخدمات السحابية المجتمعية المقدَّمة للجهات المستفيدة، بما فيها الجهات الحكومية وجهات البنية التحتية الوطنية الحساسة، عن أي حوسبة سحابية مقدَّمة خارج نطاق العمل.
evAr:
• Architectural design documentation.
• Sample isolation mechanisms implemented between cloud services provided to government and sensitive-infrastructure entities and cloud services provided to other external entities.

desc: Providing cloud computing services from within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including systems used for storage, processing, and disaster recovery centers.
ev:
• Cloud data centers located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
• Architectural design document for storage systems, processing systems, and disaster recovery centers, including their geographical locations and whether they are leased or owned.
• Evidence illustrating the addresses of the centers’ locations.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: تقديم خدمات الحوسبة السحابية من داخل المملكة العربية السعودية، بما في ذلك الأنظمة المستخدمة للتخزين والمعالجة ومراكز التعافي من الكوارث.
evAr:
• Cloud data centers located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
• Architectural design document for storage systems, processing systems, and disaster recovery centers, including their geographical locations and whether they are leased or owned.
• Evidence illustrating the addresses of the centers’ locations.

desc: Providing cloud computing services from within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including systems used for monitoring and support.
ev:
• Evidence that cloud-computing monitoring and support centers are based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
• Architectural design document for storage systems, processing systems, and disaster recovery centers, including their geographical locations.
• Sample contracts showing whether facilities are leased or owned.
• Evidence illustrating the addresses of the centers’ locations.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: تقديم خدمات الحوسبة السحابية من داخل المملكة العربية السعودية، بما في ذلك الأنظمة المستخدمة للمراقبة والدعم.
evAr:
• Evidence that cloud-computing monitoring and support centers are based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
• Architectural design document for storage systems, processing systems, and disaster recovery centers, including their geographical locations.
• Sample contracts showing whether facilities are leased or owned.
• Evidence illustrating the addresses of the centers’ locations.

desc: Modern technologies, such as Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), shall be used to ensure that the CSP’s information servers and processing-system devices are ready for rapid response to incidents.
ev:
• EDR systems implemented across all devices and servers.
• EDR system configuration review plan and reports.
• EDR system update plan and reports.
subT: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
descAr: يجب استخدام تقنيات حديثة، مثل الكشف والاستجابة على الأجهزة الطرفية (EDR)، لضمان جاهزية خوادم المعلومات وأجهزة أنظمة المعالجة لدى مقدّم الخدمة للاستجابة السريعة للحوادث.
evAr:
• EDR systems implemented across all devices and servers.
• EDR system configuration review plan and reports.
• EDR system update plan and reports.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-5-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for network security management, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-5-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لإدارة أمن الشبكات بحد أدنى:

desc: Monitoring traffic across external and internal networks to detect anomalies.
ev:
• Inventory of network flows.
• Anomaly-detection rules defined on detection tools.
descAr: مراقبة حركة البيانات عبر الشبكات الخارجية والداخلية لاكتشاف الحالات غير الطبيعية.
evAr:
• Inventory of network flows.
• Anomaly-detection rules defined on detection tools.

desc: Network isolation and protection of the Cloud Technology Stack network from other internal and external networks.
ev:
• Threat model for the Cloud Technology Stack network.
• Network-level controls implementation.
• Architecture design documentation.
descAr: عزل شبكة منظومة التقنية السحابية وحمايتها عن الشبكات الداخلية والخارجية الأخرى.
evAr:
• Threat model for the Cloud Technology Stack network.
• Network-level controls implementation.
• Architecture design documentation.

desc: Protection from denial-of-service attacks, including Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS).
ev: • Document or report demonstrating that denial-of-service threats are analyzed, detected, and mitigated.
descAr: الحماية من هجمات حجب الخدمة، بما في ذلك هجمات حجب الخدمة الموزعة (DDoS).
evAr: • Document or report demonstrating that denial-of-service threats are analyzed, detected, and mitigated.

desc: Protection of data transmitted through the network to and from the Cloud Technology Stack using strong cryptographic mechanisms for management and administrative access.
ev: • Evidence illustrating that Cloud Technology Stack management networks are strongly encrypted.
descAr: حماية البيانات المنقولة عبر الشبكة من وإلى منظومة التقنية السحابية باستخدام آليات تشفير قوية للوصول الإداري والتشغيلي.
evAr: • Evidence illustrating that Cloud Technology Stack management networks are strongly encrypted.

desc: Access control between different network segments.
ev:
• Network connections assigned to authenticated users or identities.
• Access-control list.
descAr: التحكم في الوصول بين أجزاء الشبكة المختلفة.
evAr:
• Network connections assigned to authenticated users or identities.
• Access-control list.

desc: Isolation between the cloud service delivery network, cloud management network, and CSP enterprise network.
ev:
• Isolation mechanisms for networks.
• Architecture design documentation.
descAr: العزل بين شبكة تقديم الخدمات السحابية وشبكة إدارة السحابة وشبكة مقدّم الخدمة المؤسسية.
evAr:
• Isolation mechanisms for networks.
• Architecture design documentation.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-6-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for mobile device security, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-6-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لأمن الأجهزة المحمولة بحد أدنى:

desc: Inventory of all end-user and mobile devices.
ev:
• Maintained inventory of end-user and mobile devices.
• Periodic review reports.
descAr: حصر جميع أجهزة المستخدمين النهائيين والأجهزة المحمولة.
evAr:
• Maintained inventory of end-user and mobile devices.
• Periodic review reports.

desc: Centralized mobile-device security management.
ev:
• All mobile devices centrally managed from a security perspective.
• Sample system configuration.
descAr: الإدارة المركزية لأمن الأجهزة المحمولة.
evAr:
• All mobile devices centrally managed from a security perspective.
• Sample system configuration.

desc: Screen locking for end-user devices.
ev:
• Screen-lock policy enforced on user devices.
• Documents illustrating user-awareness methods for manually locking screens when users are away from their devices.
descAr: إقفال الشاشة لأجهزة المستخدمين النهائيين.
evAr:
• Screen-lock policy enforced on user devices.
• Documents illustrating user-awareness methods for manually locking screens when users are away from their devices.

desc: Data sanitization and secure disposal for end-user devices, especially devices exposed to the Cloud Technology Stack.
ev: • Approved and implemented data-sanitization and device-disposal tools and methods for end-user devices related to the Cloud Technology Stack.
descAr: تطهير البيانات والتخلص الآمن من أجهزة المستخدمين النهائيين، وخصوصًا الأجهزة المتصلة بمنظومة التقنية السحابية.
evAr: • Approved and implemented data-sanitization and device-disposal tools and methods for end-user devices related to the Cloud Technology Stack.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-7-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for data and information protection, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-7-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لحماية البيانات والمعلومات بحد أدنى:

desc: Prohibiting the use of Cloud Technology Stack data in any environment other than the production environment, except after applying strict controls such as data masking or data scrambling.
ev:
• Production data segregated from test data.
• Architecture design documentation.
descAr: منع استخدام بيانات منظومة التقنية السحابية في أي بيئة غير بيئة الإنتاج، إلا بعد تطبيق ضوابط صارمة مثل إخفاء البيانات أو تشويشها.
evAr:
• Production data segregated from test data.
• Architecture design documentation.

desc: Providing CSTs with secure data-storage processes, procedures, and technologies to comply with related legal and regulatory requirements.
ev:
• List of applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
• Data-storage processes and technologies compliant with legal requirements.
descAr: تزويد الجهات المستفيدة بعمليات وإجراءات وتقنيات تخزين آمن للبيانات للالتزام بالمتطلبات التشريعية والتنظيمية ذات العلاقة.
evAr:
• List of applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
• Data-storage processes and technologies compliant with legal requirements.

desc: Disposal of CST data shall be performed securely upon termination or expiry of the contract with the CSP.
ev:
• Contract-status monitoring.
• Records of disposed CST data specifying the disposal methods used.
descAr: يجب التخلص من بيانات الجهة المستفيدة بشكل آمن عند إنهاء العقد مع مقدّم الخدمة السحابية أو انتهائه.
evAr:
• Contract-status monitoring.
• Records of disposed CST data specifying the disposal methods used.

desc: Commitment to maintain the confidentiality of CST data and information in accordance with related legal and regulatory requirements.
ev: • Evidence that storage and processing of CST data are subject to applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
descAr: الالتزام بالمحافظة على سرية بيانات ومعلومات الجهة المستفيدة وفقًا للمتطلبات التشريعية والتنظيمية ذات العلاقة.
evAr: • Evidence that storage and processing of CST data are subject to applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

desc: Providing CSTs with secure means to export and transfer data and virtual infrastructure.
ev: • Secure data and asset export functionality over an encrypted and secure channel or connection.
descAr: تزويد الجهات المستفيدة بوسائل آمنة لتصدير ونقل البيانات والبنية التحتية الافتراضية.
evAr: • Secure data and asset export functionality over an encrypted and secure channel or connection.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-8-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for cryptography, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-8-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية للتشفير بحد أدنى:

desc: Technical mechanisms and cryptographic primitives for strong encryption in accordance with the advanced level of the National Cryptographic Standards (NCS-1:2020).
ev: • NCS-1:2020-compliant data-encryption mechanisms.
descAr: الآليات التقنية وأوليات التشفير للتشفير القوي، بما يتوافق مع المستوى المتقدم في المعايير الوطنية للتشفير (NCS-1:2020).
evAr: • NCS-1:2020-compliant data-encryption mechanisms.

desc: Certification authority and certificate-issuance capability shall be implemented securely, or certificates shall be issued by a trusted certification authority.
ev:
• Installation and activation of a trusted source or authority for accreditation.
• Trusted and certified certificates.
descAr: يجب تطبيق سلطة إصدار الشهادات وقدرة إصدارها بشكل آمن، أو إصدار الشهادات من سلطة إصدار موثوقة.
evAr:
• Installation and activation of a trusted source or authority for accreditation.
• Trusted and certified certificates.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-9-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for backup and recovery management, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-9-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لإدارة النسخ الاحتياطية والاستعادة بحد أدنى:

desc: Securing access, storage, and transfer of CST data backups and their media and protecting them against damage, amendment, or unauthorized access.
ev:
• List of identified risks.
• Defined and applied security measures.
• Regular review reports.
descAr: تأمين الوصول إلى النسخ الاحتياطية لبيانات الجهة المستفيدة ووسائطها وتخزينها ونقلها، وحمايتها من التلف أو التعديل أو الوصول غير المصرّح به.
evAr:
• List of identified risks.
• Defined and applied security measures.
• Regular review reports.

desc: Securing access, storage, and transfer of Cloud Technology Stack backups and their media and protecting them against damage, amendment, or unauthorized access.
ev:
• List of identified risks.
• Defined and applied security measures.
• Regular review reports.
descAr: تأمين الوصول إلى النسخ الاحتياطية لمنظومة التقنية السحابية ووسائطها وتخزينها ونقلها، وحمايتها من التلف أو التعديل أو الوصول غير المصرّح به.
evAr:
• List of identified risks.
• Defined and applied security measures.
• Regular review reports.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-10-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for vulnerability management, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-10-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لإدارة الثغرات بحد أدنى:

desc: Assessing and remediating vulnerabilities on external components of the Cloud Technology Stack at least monthly, and internal components at least every three months.
ev:
• Threat and Vulnerability Management Policy.
• Sample vulnerability assessments.
• Sample remediation plans and actions.
descAr: تقييم الثغرات ومعالجتها على المكونات الخارجية لمنظومة التقنية السحابية شهريًا على الأقل، وعلى المكونات الداخلية كل ثلاثة أشهر على الأقل.
evAr:
• Threat and Vulnerability Management Policy.
• Sample vulnerability assessments.
• Sample remediation plans and actions.

desc: Notification to CSTs of identified vulnerabilities that may affect them and the safeguards in place.
ev: • Reports sent to CSTs regarding detected vulnerabilities that affect them.
descAr: إشعار الجهات المستفيدة بالثغرات المكتشفة التي قد تؤثر عليها وبالتدابير الوقائية المطبَّقة.
evAr: • Reports sent to CSTs regarding detected vulnerabilities that affect them.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-11-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrol for penetration testing, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-11-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضابط الفرعي الإضافي التالي لاختبار الاختراق بحد أدنى:

desc: The scope of penetration tests shall cover the entire Cloud Technology Stack and the tests shall be conducted at least once every six months.
ev: • Penetration tests conducted across the entire Cloud Technology Stack.
descAr: يجب أن يغطي نطاق اختبارات الاختراق منظومة التقنية السحابية بالكامل، وأن تُجرى الاختبارات مرة كل ستة أشهر على الأقل.
evAr: • Penetration tests conducted across the entire Cloud Technology Stack.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-12-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for cybersecurity event logs and monitoring management, as a minimum:
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-12-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لإدارة سجلات أحداث الأمن السيبراني ومراقبتها بحد أدنى:

desc: Activating and protecting event logs and audit trails of the Cloud Technology Stack.
ev:
• Log management policy.
• Centralized and protected log repository.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: تفعيل وحماية سجلات الأحداث ومسارات التدقيق لمنظومة التقنية السحابية.
evAr:
• Log management policy.
• Centralized and protected log repository.

desc: Activating and collecting login-attempt history.
ev:
• Stored and recorded login attempts.
• Evidence illustrating mechanisms for verifying login attempts.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: تفعيل وجمع سجل محاولات تسجيل الدخول.
evAr:
• Stored and recorded login attempts.
• Evidence illustrating mechanisms for verifying login attempts.

desc: Activating and protecting all event logs of activities and operations performed by the CSP at the tenant level to support forensic analysis.
ev: • CSP and CST event or activity logs.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: تفعيل وحماية جميع سجلات أحداث الأنشطة والعمليات التي ينفذها مقدّم الخدمة على مستوى الجهة المستفيدة لدعم التحليل الجنائي الرقمي.
evAr: • CSP and CST event or activity logs.

desc: Protecting cybersecurity event logs from alteration, disclosure, destruction, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release in accordance with regulatory or legal requirements.
ev:
• Cybersecurity event logs protected.
• Restrictions applied to protect the logs.
• Secure log-destruction methods.
• List of legal and regulatory requirements for audit logs.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: حماية سجلات أحداث الأمن السيبراني من التعديل أو الإفصاح أو الإتلاف أو الوصول غير المصرّح به أو النشر غير المصرّح به وفقًا للمتطلبات التنظيمية أو التشريعية.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity event logs protected.
• Restrictions applied to protect the logs.
• Secure log-destruction methods.
• List of legal and regulatory requirements for audit logs.

desc: Continuous cybersecurity event monitoring using SIEM technology covering the full Cloud Technology Stack.
ev:
• Cybersecurity logs monitored in a SIEM system.
• List of requirements for cybersecurity event monitoring.
• Sample monitoring reports or alerts.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: المراقبة المستمرة لأحداث الأمن السيبراني باستخدام تقنية إدارة معلومات وأحداث الأمن (SIEM) بما يغطي منظومة التقنية السحابية بالكامل.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity logs monitored in a SIEM system.
• List of requirements for cybersecurity event monitoring.
• Sample monitoring reports or alerts.

desc: Reviewing cybersecurity event logs and audit trails periodically, covering CSP events in the Cloud Technology Stack.
ev:
• Cybersecurity event logs reviewed by skilled and independent reviewers.
• Sample reports, alerts, or use cases.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: مراجعة سجلات أحداث الأمن السيبراني ومسارات التدقيق دوريًا، بما يغطي أحداث مقدّم الخدمة في منظومة التقنية السحابية.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity event logs reviewed by skilled and independent reviewers.
• Sample reports, alerts, or use cases.

desc: Automated monitoring and logging of remote-access session event logs.
ev: • Remote-access sessions automatically monitored.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: المراقبة والتسجيل الآلي لسجلات أحداث جلسات الوصول عن بُعد.
evAr: • Remote-access sessions automatically monitored.

desc: Secure handling of user-related data found in audit trails and cybersecurity event logs.
ev: • Personally Identifiable Information anonymized in logs.
subT: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
descAr: التعامل الآمن مع بيانات المستخدمين الموجودة في مسارات التدقيق وسجلات أحداث الأمن السيبراني.
evAr: • Personally Identifiable Information anonymized in logs.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-13-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for cybersecurity incident and threat management, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-13-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية لإدارة حوادث وتهديدات الأمن السيبراني بحد أدنى:

desc: Subscribing to authorized and specialized organizations and groups to stay up to date on cybersecurity threats, common practices, and key know-how.
ev:
• List of trusted external threat-intelligence vendors.
• Cybersecurity threat intelligence.
• Knowledge base of common and best practices in cybersecurity.
descAr: الاشتراك في الجهات والمجموعات المعتمدة والمتخصصة للبقاء على اطلاع بتهديدات الأمن السيبراني والممارسات الشائعة والمعرفة الأساسية.
evAr:
• List of trusted external threat-intelligence vendors.
• Cybersecurity threat intelligence.
• Knowledge base of common and best practices in cybersecurity.

desc: Training employees and third-party personnel to respond to cybersecurity incidents in accordance with their roles and responsibilities.
ev:
• Cybersecurity training program aligned with the roles and responsibilities of the target groups.
• Sample training certificates or attendance records.
descAr: تدريب الموظفين والعاملين من الأطراف الخارجية على الاستجابة لحوادث الأمن السيبراني وفقًا لأدوارهم ومسؤولياتهم.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity training program aligned with the roles and responsibilities of the target groups.
• Sample training certificates or attendance records.

desc: Periodically testing the cybersecurity incident-response capability.
ev:
• Incident response plan or procedure test schedule.
• Report outlining the methodology for testing cybersecurity incident-response capabilities.
• Lessons-learned records.
descAr: الاختبار الدوري لقدرة الاستجابة لحوادث الأمن السيبراني.
evAr:
• Incident response plan or procedure test schedule.
• Report outlining the methodology for testing cybersecurity incident-response capabilities.
• Lessons-learned records.

desc: Performing root-cause analysis of cybersecurity incidents and developing plans to address the findings.
ev:
• Root-cause analysis established as a mandatory part of incident response.
• Root-cause analysis conclusions prioritized and addressed.
• Incident response plan continuously improved based on root-cause analysis conclusions.
• Sample root-cause analysis.
descAr: إجراء تحليل السبب الجذري لحوادث الأمن السيبراني ووضع خطط لمعالجة النتائج.
evAr:
• Root-cause analysis established as a mandatory part of incident response.
• Root-cause analysis conclusions prioritized and addressed.
• Incident response plan continuously improved based on root-cause analysis conclusions.
• Sample root-cause analysis.

desc: Supporting the CST in legal proceedings and forensics while protecting the chain of custody under the CSP’s management and responsibility.
ev:
• Evidence demonstrating knowledge and understanding of legal and regulatory requirements for CSTs.
• Legal and forensic capabilities established.
• Movement of evidence tracked and evidence integrity ensured.
descAr: دعم الجهة المستفيدة في الإجراءات القانونية والتحليل الجنائي الرقمي مع حماية سلسلة الحيازة تحت إدارة ومسؤولية مقدّم الخدمة.
evAr:
• Evidence demonstrating knowledge and understanding of legal and regulatory requirements for CSTs.
• Legal and forensic capabilities established.
• Movement of evidence tracked and evidence integrity ensured.

desc: Real-time reporting to the CST of incidents that may affect the CST when an incident is discovered.
ev:
• Impact on CSTs analyzed for all identified incidents.
• Incidents affecting CSTs immediately reported to the CSTs with sufficient information.
• Sample incidents reported to CSTs.
descAr: الإبلاغ الفوري للجهة المستفيدة عن الحوادث التي قد تؤثر عليها عند اكتشاف الحادثة.
evAr:
• Impact on CSTs analyzed for all identified incidents.
• Incidents affecting CSTs immediately reported to the CSTs with sufficient information.
• Sample incidents reported to CSTs.

desc: Supporting CSTs in handling security incidents in accordance with the agreement between the CSP and CST.
ev:
• Incident-handling process agreed between the CSP and CST and formally recognized in the contract.
• Process established for reporting incidents affecting CSTs.
descAr: دعم الجهات المستفيدة في التعامل مع الحوادث الأمنية وفقًا للاتفاقية المبرمة بين مقدّم الخدمة والجهة المستفيدة.
evAr:
• Incident-handling process agreed between the CSP and CST and formally recognized in the contract.
• Process established for reporting incidents affecting CSTs.

desc: Measuring and monitoring cybersecurity incident metrics and monitoring compliance with contracts and legislative requirements.
ev:
• Contractual and legislative requirements register.
• Formally approved and tested cybersecurity incident metrics, including KPIs and KCIs.
• Metrics dashboards and compliance reports.
• Records of dashboard and compliance-report reviews.
• Sample dashboard and compliance report.
descAr: قياس ومراقبة مؤشرات حوادث الأمن السيبراني ومراقبة الالتزام بالعقود والمتطلبات التشريعية.
evAr:
• Contractual and legislative requirements register.
• Formally approved and tested cybersecurity incident metrics, including KPIs and KCIs.
• Metrics dashboards and compliance reports.
• Records of dashboard and compliance-report reviews.
• Sample dashboard and compliance report.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-14-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrols for physical security, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-14-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضوابط الفرعية الإضافية التالية للأمن المادي بحد أدنى:

desc: Continuous monitoring of access to the CSP’s sites and buildings.
ev:
• Inventory of site and building gates and access points.
• Documentation of defined attack vectors, access-monitoring requirements, and the access-monitoring process.
• Access logs and records.
• Access-log and record reviews.
descAr: المراقبة المستمرة للدخول إلى مواقع ومباني مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr:
• Inventory of site and building gates and access points.
• Documentation of defined attack vectors, access-monitoring requirements, and the access-monitoring process.
• Access logs and records.
• Access-log and record reviews.

desc: Preventing unauthorized access to devices in the Cloud Technology Stack.
ev:
• Closed physical perimeter for servers and data storage with access-control points.
• Devices locked in secure racks to prevent damage and insertion of external portable devices.
descAr: منع الوصول غير المصرّح به إلى الأجهزة في منظومة التقنية السحابية.
evAr:
• Closed physical perimeter for servers and data storage with access-control points.
• Devices locked in secure racks to prevent damage and insertion of external portable devices.

desc: Secure disposal of cloud infrastructure hardware and storage equipment.
ev:
• Applicable legal regulations and best practices for hardware disposal.
• Formally approved cloud infrastructure hardware-disposal policy.
• Hardware-disposal records and tracking system.
descAr: التخلص الآمن من أجهزة البنية التحتية السحابية ومعدات التخزين.
evAr:
• Applicable legal regulations and best practices for hardware disposal.
• Formally approved cloud infrastructure hardware-disposal policy.
• Hardware-disposal records and tracking system.

desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-15-3, the CSP shall cover the following additional subcontrol for web application security, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضوابط الفرعية في الضابط 2-15-3 من الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب على مقدّم الخدمة السحابية تغطية الضابط الفرعي الإضافي التالي لأمن تطبيقات الويب بحد أدنى:

desc: Protecting information involved in application-service transactions against risks such as incomplete transmission, misrouting, unauthorized alteration, and unauthorized disclosure.
ev:
• Web application firewalls appropriately configured.
• Traffic inspection and behavioral monitoring established.
• Access from known malicious or bad-reputation sources denied.
• Data-transmission encryption and integrity-protection layer, such as TLS/SSL, applied.
• Regular review of application exposure to the Internet and detection of unintentional data exposure.
• Default or common application passwords denied.
• Detection of malicious or unintentional routing-table changes or service redirections implemented.
• Ongoing transaction monitoring established.
descAr: حماية المعلومات المتضمنة في معاملات خدمات التطبيقات من مخاطر مثل النقل غير المكتمل أو التوجيه الخاطئ أو التعديل غير المصرّح به أو الإفصاح غير المصرّح به.
evAr:
• Web application firewalls appropriately configured.
• Traffic inspection and behavioral monitoring established.
• Access from known malicious or bad-reputation sources denied.
• Data-transmission encryption and integrity-protection layer, such as TLS/SSL, applied.
• Regular review of application exposure to the Internet and detection of unintentional data exposure.
• Default or common application passwords denied.
• Detection of malicious or unintentional routing-table changes or service redirections implemented.
• Ongoing transaction monitoring established.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for the key management process within the CSP shall be identified, documented, and approved.
ev:
• Key Management standard formally approved and periodically reviewed.
• Regular review reports.
descAr: يجب تحديد وتوثيق واعتماد متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لعملية إدارة المفاتيح لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr:
• Key Management standard formally approved and periodically reviewed.
• Regular review reports.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for the key management process within the CSP shall be applied.
ev: • Cybersecurity requirements for the key management process implemented and followed in accordance with the defined policy and related documentation.
descAr: يجب تطبيق متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لعملية إدارة المفاتيح لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr: • Cybersecurity requirements for the key management process implemented and followed in accordance with the defined policy and related documentation.

desc: In addition to ECC subcontrol 2-8-3-2, cybersecurity requirements for key management within the CSP shall cover, as a minimum:
descAr: إضافة إلى الضابط الفرعي 2-8-3-2 في الضوابط الأساسية (ECC)، يجب أن تغطي متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لإدارة المفاتيح لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية بحد أدنى ما يلي:

desc: Ensuring well-defined ownership for cryptographic keys.
ev: • Identified cryptographic keys and assigned owners.
descAr: ضمان تحديد ملكية واضحة لمفاتيح التشفير.
evAr: • Identified cryptographic keys and assigned owners.

desc: A secure cryptographic-key retrieval mechanism in case a cryptographic key is lost, such as backup and trusted key storage strictly external to the cloud.
ev: • Cryptographic-key retrieval plan.
descAr: آلية آمنة لاستعادة مفتاح التشفير في حال فقدانه، مثل النسخ الاحتياطي وتخزين المفاتيح في مكان موثوق خارج السحابة تمامًا.
evAr: • Cryptographic-key retrieval plan.

desc: Logging and monitoring key-management activities.

• Comparison of the list of active cloud services with the list of monitored cloud services.

• Comparison of the list of active cloud services with the list of monitored cloud services.
• Sample SIEM reports, alerts, or use cases.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for key management within the CSP shall be applied and reviewed periodically.

• Cybersecurity requirements for Key Management reviewed periodically.

descAr: يجب تطبيق متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لإدارة المفاتيح لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية ومراجعتها دوريًا.
evAr:
• Cybersecurity requirements for Key Management reviewed periodically.
• Periodic review logs.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for system development within the CSP shall be identified, documented, and approved.

descAr: يجب تحديد وتوثيق واعتماد متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لتطوير الأنظمة لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.
evAr: • Cybersecurity requirements for system development formally approved and periodically reviewed.

desc: Cybersecurity requirements for system development within the CSP shall be applied.

• Enforced cybersecurity requirements for system development.
• Document outlining implementation of the compliance-measurement tool for the standard.
• Documents defining violation-escalation procedures.
descAr: يجب تطبيق متطلبات الأمن السيبراني لتطوير الأنظمة لدى مقدّم الخدمة السحابية.

• Enforced cybersecurity requirements for system development.
• Document outlining implementation of the compliance-measurement tool for the standard.
• Documents defining violation-escalation procedures.
